stop_basis.primary_reason: source-loss events cannot be distinguished from possible grouped-island count redistribution without opening response patterns or obtaining an external row-level reconstruction key
stop_basis.secondary_risk: the mixed public table has no survey-effort/surveyed flag column, so zero semantics also require external documentation rather than inference from missing rows

why_this_matters: A redistributed grouped-island count can manufacture island-level presence, persistence, loss or recolonization. Because source-loss leverage is defined from changes in occupied island identity, such rows cannot be allowed into the event definition without a prospectively identifiable reconstruction flag.
forbidden_repairs: infer reconstructed rows from fractional or unusual Eider_pairs values

treat every missing island-year as zero
treat rounded Lon/Lat as exact topology
use pos2 response-row values to rescue the reconstruction problem
proceed because this lane is only retrospective
what_would_reopen_schema_work: an official row-level flag or ancillary key identifying redistributed grouped-island observations
an official exact keyed spatial object if topology beyond the public pos2 representation is required
